Users with statuses for a table

Source: R/protection.R
aa_users_overview.Rd

A list of users with the flags needed for the table on the access management tab: whether the user is blocked by an administrator, whether login is blocked after failed attempts and how much time is left. If the attempts tables are unavailable, the attempt-based lockout status is treated as absent.

Usage

aa_users_overview(conn, settings = aa_settings())

Arguments

conn

A connection to the SQLite database (DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), ...)).

settings

Settings, the result of aa_settings().

Value

A table with columns login, role, blocked, state ("blocked" for a block by an administrator, "locked" for a lockout by attempts, otherwise "ok"), lock_seconds (seconds until the attempt lockout ends) and status (status text in the settings language, an empty string for "ok"), as well as created_at and last_login_at (dates from the database in UTC, as in aa_get_user()) and created and last_login (the same dates for display: server local time, with the texts for "unknown" and "never logged in" for unknown dates), as well as has_email (1 if an email is set for password recovery; the address itself is not included), totp_on (1 if the user has 2FA enabled) and autologins (how many active autologins, see aa_active_autologins()).

Examples

if (requireNamespace("RSQLite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  conn <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), ":memory:")
  aa_init_db(conn)
  aa_create_first_admin(conn, "boss", "boss-password")
  aa_users_overview(conn)
  DBI::dbDisconnect(conn)
}
